additional_displays.expansion: physics-only expansion-consistent region; no trained expansion head exists in this composite
additional_displays.thin_front: hybrid NMS candidate, separately reported; original orange response area is NOT shock thickness or a validated influence region

cfd_contract.independence: ellipse runs share one geometry-family cluster; 243 frames are not 243 independent cases
cfd_contract.qualification: File completeness, finite positive fluid states, exact geometry and coordinates before predictions. Solver completion is not steady convergence or physical shedding validation.
cfd_contract.state_selection: all 81 stored states, including initialization; smoke runs excluded

metrics_to_freeze_before_scoring.aggregation: per-case results first; paired differences, not pooled-pixel significance; no confidence interval over three highly related runs
metrics_to_freeze_before_scoring.decision: No numerical success threshold inferred from the forthcoming test results. A failure stays a failure; tuning retires the case from prospective status.
shock: bidirectional normal/front distance in L and cells
vortex: reference center recall and localization in L
wake_shear: boundary distance and region overlap only where independent boundary reference exists; otherwise descriptive

ordered_gates.complete_when: Frozen forwards on all registered cases, provenance and full-field early/middle/late review; success judged only with independent references
ordered_gates.name: prospective transfer

ordered_gates.complete_when: Same inputs/references for HJ-OP, composite and registered baselines; report all outcomes and runtime; original 15-model campaign remains a separate weak-reference comparison
ordered_gates.name: matched comparisons and ablations

ordered_gates.complete_when: Accepted SU2 analytic rays for shock geometry plus independently specified exact translating-vortex/expansion tests; no teacher mask used as its own accuracy reference. Real-case core boundary accuracy requires independent reference, not Q/lambda reuse.
ordered_gates.name: independent reference

ordered_gates.complete_when: Prespecified wake-onset length, shear-width evolution, vortex-center trajectories and shock-motion coupling compared with independent raw probes/references; no causal/periodic claim without temporal support
ordered_gates.name: scientific measurement

primary_model.background: observed fluid outside the union of the three learned masks; independent labels may overlap
primary_model.geometry: Output validity mask only, not a learned input channel
primary_model.input: seven harmonized CFD channels; NOT image-only schlieren
primary_model.reference: Explicit upstream rho, p, velocity, gamma and declared body major length; never estimated by test-frame quantile

config.purpose: Freeze the current experimental composite before receiving new CFD; not a promotion or a successful-generalization claim.

prospective_scope: future registered CFD only; historical development is retrospective
